note: ONE AI ADAPTER REGISTRY (PHASE A4.1, owner 2026-09-23). Machine-readable declaration of every AI adapter DNA OS can select. This is the ONLY place where 'which provider/model sits behind which capability' is expressed; business callers name a capability only. It deliberately does NOT reuse registry/AI_REGISTRY.json, which declares AI agents/tools (claude-code, gemini-cli, …) with different semantics. Model identity lives in `configuration`, never in a capability id. A declared-but-not-executable provider is not an adapter: see `execution.status`. A8: adapters now declare capabilities_by_runtime — where each capability is really available — because the same adapter can serve a different set in each runtime (the device watcher's vision/text work vs the Next gateway's routing). Priority stays a single per-adapter value; no capability→provider map exists anywhere.

authority.selection: services/ai/resolver.ts (single logical selection authority, same contract in every runtime)

policy.tie_break: priority ascending, then adapter id ascending (deterministic)

capabilities.conversation.answer: answer a customer/user conversation turn (Workspace caller: cognitive/pipeline.ts#answerWithAi)
capabilities.intent.classify: classify what the caller is asking for
capabilities.screen.describe: read a screen capture and say what is on it / what to click next
capabilities.document.ocr: read text out of an image/PDF document
capabilities.document.event_extract: extract structured business fields out of a document
capabilities.document.crop: locate or crop the document region inside an image
capabilities.material.resolve: resolve free-text material wording to a material
capabilities.code.generate: produce a code/proposal artifact for Owner approval
capabilities.text.entity_extract: A5.5 ADDED — extract structured business entities (material/quantity/contact/project/destination/vehicle) from free Thai text. Source evidence: supabase/functions/line-webhook-v2/helpers.ts#extractStructuredEntitiesWithGemini (named by the WORK, not by Gemini)
capabilities.location.geocode: A5.5 ADDED — turn a written address into latitude/longitude. Source evidence: supabase/functions/line-webhook-v2/helpers.ts#resolveAddressToCoordinates (named by the WORK, not by Gemini)
